newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR LARGELY WEAKER UNDER PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR LARGELY WEAKER UNDER PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer against most hard currencies on the back of import pressure on Wednesday morning.

"We saw some (foreign currency) buying late yesterday and this morning. The Reserve Bank has already come in with support for the Zimbabwe dollar but it looks like the pressure is still there," one foreign exchange dealer said.
At around 0745 GMT the local dollar was quoted a cent weaker on the U.S unit at 11.3050/3150 compared to Tuesday's 11.2950/3050 close and was at 6.5380/5415 from 6.5200/5400 against the mark.
It slipped to 2.5390/5420 from 2.5300/5400 against the rand but was firmer at 18.3570/3680 versus pound sterling from 18.3800/4000.
